mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates strengthening labor market conditions, leading to increased consumer spending and corporate investment, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE decreases over the 5-day horizon (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate crosses above 4.5% in a 3-month window, signaling aggressive monetary tightening, it raises borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite the rate crossing above 4.5%, or the signal is not preceded by a tightening cycle (as indicated by other indicators).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both GDP growth (GDPC1) and industrial production (RSAFS) reflects robust demand across sectors, which amplifies equity valuation growth and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and RSAFS show upward trends over the 5-day horizon (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 3.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing long-term interest rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS remains below 3.5%, or the signal is not accompanied by other easing indicators (e.g., CPIAUCSL).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) crosses above 4.5% in a 3-month window, signaling labor market weakening, it reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite UNRATE exceeding 4.5%, or the signal is not part of a broader labor market contraction.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust supply-side growth, which reduces inflationary pressures and supports equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both INDPRO and HOUST show upward trends over the 5-day horizon (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trajectory in industrial production (INDPRO) over time reflects long-term supply-side expansion, which enhances corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO shows a sustained upward trend over the 20-day horizon (t-test p > 0.05).
